entities.summary: Bruce Cooper Clarke was a United States Army general. He was a career officer who served in World War I, World War II, and the Korean War. He was the commander of United States Army, Pacific from December 1954 to April 1956, Continental Army Command from 1958 to 1960, and commanded United States Army, Europe from 1960 to 1962.
